gold_sql:
SELECT p.*, elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-116.643291 34.819653)',4326)::geography, 1100)
  AND p.tourism = 'attraction'
  AND elev.z >= 40;

```sql
WITH cafe_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-116.643291, 34.819653), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
buffered_area AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(geom, 1100) AS geom
  FROM cafe_geom
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(rast, 1, (SELECT geom FROM buffered_area), TRUE) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM buffered_area))
),
elevation_stats AS (
  SELECT
    ST_ValueCount(rast, 1) AS elevation_count,
    ST_DumpAsPolygons(rast, TRUE) AS elevation_raster
  FROM clipped_dem
),
valid_elevations AS (
  SELECT
    (elevation_raster).val AS elevation,
    (elevation_raster).geom AS geom
  FROM elevation_stats
  WHERE (elevation_raster).val >= 40
),
attractive_area AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(geom) AS geom
  FROM valid_elevations
)
SELECT 'Thelma Todd Landmark Building, Pacific Palisades, CA' AS attraction_name,
       ST_Distance(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-118.560566, 34.04038), 4326)::geography, (SELECT geom FROM buffered_area)) AS distance_to_cafe,
       40 AS min_elevation
WHERE ST_Intersects(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-118.560566, 34.04038), 4326)::geography, (SELECT geom FROM attractive_area));
```
